{{Quote|Both houses concur: I will act as unbiased party in choosing charity. Will announce decision of Broken Valley Relief Fund (Balmorra) tomorrow.|Denri Ayl's notes|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Broken Valley Relief Fund''' was a relief charity that benefited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and was named after the [[Broken Valley]]. during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After negotiations overseen by [[Denri Ayl]], both [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and [[House Renar]] donated fifty thousand credits each to the charity.
